ops-bot: [intel] RivalA pilot flagged for Orcasys (partner_channel). confidence=medium. ts=3775000600.

Jake: Sending a short health-check to Sam now and asking for a new ML contact. Owners: Ana=tech prep & PoC; Dylan=procurement brief; Maria=renewal tracker.

Sam: Got it — Wed 10am works for a quick sync. Curious which RivalA gaps you expect to beat on (latency vs cost).

Maria: Great. Ana, please prep a latency cohort comparison (ETA EOD tomorrow). Jake, book Wed 10am. We'll push a low-risk PoC offer in the meeting.

Jake: Booked Wed 10am provisional. Posting calendar link when accepted. :thumbsup:
